AFCSignals Turn Signals Flush Mount Indicators for Triumph Daytona 675

Details:

Sold as a pair (left and right).
-High quality acrylic; dark tint, white tint, and clear lenses!
-High rise flush mount design allows the turn signals to protrude slightly past the fairing allowing visibility from the front also!
-Plano convex lens refracts light within lens!
-14 SMD LED design, 220 lumen!
-Includes mounting hardware & OEM connectors for direct plug and play!
